scope: Selected A2 cover direction integrated into the module; each event version still requires explicit owner approval

body.license: Local preview with installed macOS fonts; runtime licensing not yet confirmed

title.license: Local preview with installed macOS fonts; runtime licensing not yet confirmed

font_usage: Local preview with installed macOS fonts; runtime licensing not yet confirmed
rules: Photograph fills the canvas; preserve main subject
Headline in sentence case; no forced uppercase
Text sits in quiet lower region with a gradual dark gradient
No slide counters or automatic second slide
Do not repeat facts within a card

photo_enhancement.goal: Restore usable resolution and reduce blur where feasible, then improve light and color richness while preserving identity and scene content
photo_enhancement.selection: Per-image and local adjustments; no universal aggressive filter
photo_enhancement.verification: Compare original and processed source, including close-up faces; weaken or discard unsuccessful correction
photo_enhancement.generation_for_missing_photo: Separate atmospheric illustration workflow, not face reconstruction

restoration.trigger: Original is too small or blurred for the intended crop and output size
restoration.constraint: Estimated missing pixels must not change identity, expressions, clothing, lettering, tattoos, instruments or other objects
restoration.uncertainty: Missing information cannot be guaranteed to match the original; reject content-changing reconstruction
restoration.verification: Compare restored and original subjects and objects; route uncertain identity or detail preservation to owner review
